source.integration: The accepted candidate was cherry-picked without conflict into clean root tasks-hub at the exact prerequisite base. Product and focused test content are identical to the accepted candidate; its report was subsequently expanded with actual-release evidence.

diagnosis.cause: A Board refresh replaced the whole thread while the message viewport was actively scrolling. The active #board-messages and focused composer nodes became disconnected, terminating the browser's current scroll target even though the earlier message-anchor restoration recovered a final reading position.
diagnosis.baseline: On unchanged base 8194718, isolated Chromium and Playwright WebKit each observed the active scrolling list and focused input being replaced during a browser-injected wheel refresh while all retained prepend-anchor cases passed.
diagnosis.correction: Board coalesces same-project repaint during wheel, scroll and touch activity, then renders the latest fetched state after 120 milliseconds of scroll idle using the existing anchor restoration. Touch remains held through end/cancel so later inertia scroll events can extend the idle window.
diagnosis.evidenceLimit: Playwright wheel input is browser automation, browser smooth scroll is a momentum surrogate, and the touch lifecycle is synthetic. No physical trackpad/touch, native Safari soft keyboard, owner event trace or owner-device pass is claimed.
